about.en: Forward Industries bStock (FWDIB) is a tokenized share of Forward Industries, Inc. issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0x83f1a739fae6517c4672c5e10c8ea918925eb584, backed 1:1 by FWDI shares and convertible 1:1 with the underlying equity, with stock splits and dividend adjustments processed by the issuer. bStocks are offered under an ADGM-approved prospectus and not in other jurisdictions.
